_about: Five Oaks Duck Lodge menu and prep timing. Source: /Users/cheflance/Five_Oaks/Prep List.docx (Chef Lance, 2026-10-20), with Chef's corrections of 2026-10-22 (see SKILL.md). This file, not the .docx, is now the source of truth. Each task reads '<offset>, <task>' in Chef's wording. Day offsets put the task on a dated sheet as advance prep; hour and minute offsets put it on the service-day timeline, counted back from that component's course time.
_service_times_note: Chef's times (2026-10-22): appetizers 6 PM, salad or soup 7 PM, entrees 7:30 PM, dessert 8 PM. Entrees were 7 PM and dessert 7:30 PM until the Salad or Soup course was added.
_appetizers_note: Chef's appetizer course of 2026-10-25, served at 6 PM (course 'appetizers'). Each dinner takes one Duck and one Non-duck appetizer, or none of either (request fields appetizer_duck and appetizer_nonduck). Every task comes from the dish's html SOP in /Users/cheflance/Five_Oaks/SOP (reports/SOP Prep Activities by Dish.md in the Five Oaks workspace), with Chef's 10/25 calls: pizza and flatbread toppings at -2 days, spinach dip made at -3 days, prosciutto started at -21 days. Non-duck appetizers will be added later.
_salads_soups_note: Salads & Soups is part of the dinner, one choice per night, served at 7 PM (course 'salad'). Appetizers are separate. Chef's list of 2026-10-23, numbered as he numbered it. That list replaced the SOP-derived gumbo tasks of 2026-10-22.
